Exact complement block diagonalization of its matrix yields the two sixth-degree determinant factors, hence the all-period zeta and Möbius primitive counts. Exact low-period traces rule out 1,2,3,7,8,12, while three simple common-root cycles with lengths 4,5,6 prove all asserted other primitive periods. Strong connectivity plus coprime cycle lengths yield primitive Perron entropy. Both packaged checkers ran and passed; infinite statements rely on the written algebraic and constructive proofs, not finite runs.

value.rationale: The intersection of the first two nontrivial literal binary tandem-square periods is a natural constrained symbolic system distinct from classical fully squarefree or single-period models. The complete all-period zeta is a non-obvious two-sextic product, and its primitive-period exceptions at 8 and 12 distinguish the existence of a circle from existence of a primitive circle. An explicit signed quotient and unbounded return-loop theorem explain these sharp boundaries; the specific structural information is not merely a generic consequence of regularity or a numerical check.
